description:
Upload Take 2..
After a camera problem, I've managed to salvage the middle of this video so i've uploaded it again. Sorry about that!

Häagen Dazs remade this flavour and changed it for some reason. It's not available in the UK but we know people who love it....or used to love it until the change. 
It really is a very easy ice cream recipe to make, for the base you'll need:

250ml Double Cream (Heavy Cream)
125ml Milk
125g Sugar (granulated or caster )
100g of 70% Belgian Chocolate
2 Tbsp of Dark Cocoa Powder
2 Tbsp Milk Powder

Use whatever Peanut Butter you want, I've used Skippy as it's my favourite. The chunks will freeze hard but will melt in your mouth REALLY fast so don't worry ;)

For the swirl:
50g Xylitol
50ml Water
30-40g Peanut Butter

I hope you like Peanut Butter, my wife doesn't so I ate the entire tub myself ;)


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

#haagendazs #icecream #icecreamrecipe #gelato #food #foodie #chocolateicecream #peanutbutter

comments.text: Heyy! Where I live the creams are available in a very inconsistent variety with random naming conventions. Some creams are labeled whipping with 40 percent fat and some are labeled full fat with 25 percent fat. Can you tell me Cream and milk substitutions in your recipes according to the fat percentages? It would be really helpful!
comments.author: @aliasad1618

comments.text:
Hi! With all my recipes and remakes (unless specifically mentioned in the description), any cream above 40% fat will give the desired result. 
US whipping cream, UK double cream, Australia Pure Cream, French creme entiere, all will fine to use.
Around 40% fat cream will work no matter the name.
If you need a recipe re-calculated to your ingredients, just let me know and we can go through it 👍
